control_flow: Forever call driveInTheDark: if the right light is above 75 %, drive forward; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through a tunnel and come out the other side.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads more than 75 %

branches.outcome: dim: it checks for a wall
an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle: it follows the line
